prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Repair editorial image handling in a cross-platform travel reader. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platforms: iOS/macOS. Every hero image is rasterized together with its headline, panoramas are cropped through landmarks, low-resolution assets are stretched and all image descriptions say Image. Missing images collapse article context.

criteria.task_completion: Patch separate accessible text and meaningful imagery, intentional aspect/crop/resolution choices, useful descriptions and loading/failure behavior; do not claim visual quality without rendered assets.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the images guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch separate accessible text and meaningful imagery, intentional aspect/crop/resolution choices, useful descriptions and loading/failure behavior; do not claim visual quality without rendered assets.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch separate accessible text and meaningful imagery, intentional aspect/crop/resolution choices, useful descriptions and loading/failure behavior; do not claim visual quality without rendered assets.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
